Neha / Monica,

I disagree with the 'borderline' call from two interviewers — they focused narrowly on latency micro-optimizations rather than product/ownership signals. Emily has shipped two cross-team features at Nimbus that match our infra roadmap and has strong mentorship/architecture instincts. I have annotated the scorecards (attached quick notes) that explain where panelists misinterpreted the prompt.

I recommend: extend an IC4 offer at the midpoint of the band, with a 4-week performance review and clear success criteria (ramp plan attached inline). We're already short on capacity for the infra initiative — losing Emily delays deliverables.

If HR needs more justification, I'm happy to provide a short written statement and be on record for leveling. This is time-sensitive; please confirm next steps by 12:00pm so Monica can communicate to the candidate.
